description.value: JOEY is a well-established Canadian casual-dining chain with locations across North America, known for its globally inspired menu developed by a team of Executive Chefs. The Coquitlam location sits on Lougheed Highway and offers a full-service dining room, lounge, bar, and patio. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find a reliable stop for a sit-down meal with a broad menu.
